TD-CS-50-HP-001.name: Valid Process Order — Approved Master Recipe with BOM, Routing, and IPC Steps
TD-CS-50-HP-001.expectedOutcome: Process Order created with unique Process Order number and Batch number; BOM, Routing, and IPC steps auto-populated; status CRTD or REL

TD-CS-50-NEG-001.name: Invalid Master Recipe — Draft Status (Not Approved/Released)
TD-CS-50-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Recipe status must be Approved/Released; Master Recipe field highlighted as invalid; no Process Order created

TD-CS-50-NEG-002.name: Quality Hold — Component Material on Quality Hold/Blocked Status
TD-CS-50-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Component material {material number} is on quality hold; Process Order creation blocked; no Process Order or Batch number generated

TD-CS-50-ERR-001.name: Missing Master Recipe Field
TD-CS-50-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Enter Master Recipe; Master Recipe field highlighted as mandatory; submission blocked

TD-CS-50-ERR-002.name: Missing Plant Field
TD-CS-50-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Enter Plant; Plant field highlighted as mandatory; submission blocked

TD-CS-50-ERR-003.name: Missing Order Quantity Field
TD-CS-50-ERR-003.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Enter Order Quantity; Order Quantity field highlighted as mandatory; submission blocked

TD-CS-50-ERR-004.name: Missing Production Start Date Field
TD-CS-50-ERR-004.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Enter Production Start Date; Production Start Date field highlighted as mandatory; submission blocked

TD-CS-50-ERR-005.name: Missing Material Number Field
TD-CS-50-ERR-005.expectedOutcome: System displays error: Enter Material; Material Number field highlighted as mandatory; submission blocked

TD-CS-50-EDGE-001.name: Order Quantity at Minimum Lot Size Boundary
TD-CS-50-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Process Order created successfully with order quantity equal to minimum lot size; no error or warning displayed

TD-CS-50-EDGE-002.name: Order Quantity at Maximum Lot Size Boundary
TD-CS-50-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: Process Order created successfully with order quantity equal to maximum lot size; no error or warning displayed

TD-CS-50-EDGE-003.name: Production Start Date at Current Date Boundary
TD-CS-50-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Process Order created successfully with production start date equal to current system date; no error or warning displayed
